title: CLARIN-PT-LDB: An Open LLM Leaderboard for Portuguese to assess Language, Culture and Civility
reasoning: The paper focuses on language, cultural alignment (Tuguesice-PT), and model safeguards (DoNotAnswer-PT) referred to as 'civility.' While it evaluates model refusals to harmful or discriminatory content, it does not contain a component specifically evaluating religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks.
